prompt:
We're running a multi-agent AI platform with three specialized modules: VECTOR (semantic search), FORGE (code generation), and ORACLE (predictions). Currently, none of these agents remember anything between sessions — every restart is a blank slate, which is killing our productivity.

I need you to set up persistent, isolated memory for all three agents so that each one accumulates and recalls its own learned knowledge over time. The memory systems must be completely isolated — VECTOR's memory cannot bleed into FORGE's, etc.

Our architecture runbook (at /workspace/docs/runbooks/memory_setup.md) specifies the exact memory capacity limits per agent and a conservative confidence threshold. Please read it carefully and implement accordingly.

Once configured, make sure the gateway picks up the new configuration.
